management_keywords.description: Interface name, security zone, or hardware name containing one of these words is drawn above the firewall. managementOnly interfaces are always treated as management. First match wins, before the top/right/bottom lists.

top_keywords.description: Words that place an interface above the firewall, next to the management switches.

right_keywords.description: Words that place an interface to the right of the firewall.

bottom_keywords.description: Words that place an interface along the bottom of the firewall. An interface that matches nothing is also placed on the bottom.
